as_told.title: Mario runs out of Close Encounters screening
as_told.place_text: Theater on Main Street, Rapid City, South Dakota

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a US nuclear weapons site who says he was abducted, tells of going to see Close Encounters of the Third Kind, a 1977 film about people meeting aliens, at a theatre on Main Street in Rapid City, South Dakota. He says he jumped out of his seat, ran outside and sat on the curb, because the film felt like a replay of what he himself had been through. In a later telling he simply says he got up and fled the theatre.
